context: Evaluates correct usage of the Vendure product search hook, including importing useSearch from the package, passing search/categoryId/sort inputs, and verifying the normalized product shape returned including price division by 100 and image URL formatting.

checklist.name: Import useSearch
checklist.description: The solution imports `useSearch` from `@vercel/commerce-vendure` and calls it as a hook with input values for search, categoryId, brandId, or sort.

checklist.name: found + products shape
checklist.description: The solution uses both `found` (boolean) and `products` (array) from the hook's return value, rendering conditionally based on `found`.

checklist.name: Price normalization
checklist.description: The solution correctly expects `price.value` to be the Vendure `priceWithTax` divided by 100 (e.g. 1999 becomes 19.99), not the raw integer.

checklist.name: Image URL format
checklist.description: The solution correctly expects product image URLs to have `?w=800&mode=crop` appended to the Vendure asset preview URL.

checklist.name: categoryId → collectionId
checklist.description: The solution demonstrates or tests that passing `categoryId` to `useSearch` results in `collectionId` being used in the Vendure search GraphQL variables.
